summary: DevicesMFE is a page object class for HP device management UI testing. It extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive verification and action methods for device-related workflows. Key patterns include: (1) Verification methods that use wait_for_object with configurable timeouts and exception handling, (2) Action methods for clicking various UI elements like buttons, cards, and tiles, (3) Text retrieval methods for popup content validation, (4) Multi-screen popup navigation support with next/back/done buttons, (5) Login state verification, (6) JavaScript executor usage for hidden element interaction, (7) Keyboard shortcut automation for page refresh. The class handles alpha code workarounds for dummy printer testing and includes extensive HPX What's New popup flow automation across multiple screens.
